scripts.backend:migrate: npm.cmd --workspace smartq-backend exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup: npm.cmd run install:all && npm.cmd run db:up && npm.cmd run backend:generate && npm.cmd run backend:migrate && npm.cmd run backend:seed
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build:backend && npm.cmd run build:frontend
scripts.audit:all: npm.cmd --workspace smartq-backend audit && npm.cmd --workspace frontend audit
